inputs.name: analyticsSnapshot.events
inputs.description: The analytics events considered for the snapshot, with event fields supplying the project, loop and task identities, timestamp, kind, action, statuses and model or token data where present. The filter selects among these events; an empty array produces zero counts and empty event collections.

inputs.name: analyticsSnapshot.filter
inputs.description: Optional selectors applied while choosing events: truthy project, loop and task values must match, model matches agent/evaluator models and task module/requested models, and since/until compare timestamp strings inclusively. An omitted filter defaults to an empty object; the assessment scope ignores model while model metrics receive it separately.

inputs.name: counts.items
inputs.description: The items whose string keys are counted, with one key callback invocation per item. An empty array produces an empty record.

inputs.name: counts.key
inputs.description: A callback that maps each item to its string bucket name. It is called once for every item, and its returned string becomes a key in the count record.

outputs.name: analyticsSnapshot
outputs.description: A snapshot record containing schemaVersion, generatedAt, filters, summary, loops, jev, models, tasks, benchmarks and events. JEV and task metric details come from imported implementations, so their nested schemas are not defined in this workflow.

outputs.name: counts
outputs.description: A record mapping each string returned by the key callback to the number of items with that key. Only observed key strings appear, and an empty input produces an empty record.
